claims.text: At stage-1 a wrong password makes ApiClient.login throw Exception('login failed (401)'); LoginScreen shows e.toString(), i.e. 'Exception: login failed (401)', above the Sign in button in Colors.red.

With the stage-1 theme the page and AppBar background is colorScheme.surface (0xFFFBF8FF, near white with a violet tint) and the ElevatedButton label is primary (0xFF515B92, muted indigo); the only color name in the screens' code is Colors.red.
claims.source_hint: flutter test on a stage-1 archive (ThemeData(colorSchemeSeed: Colors.indigo, useMaterial3: true)); git grep 'Colors\.' stage-1 -- DonHang.App/lib

claims.text: ThemeData holds the app-wide look (colors, text styles) and contains the ColorScheme; MaterialApp's theme makes it available to every widget below; Theme.of(context) looks upward for the nearest theme, and .colorScheme gives its roles.
claims.source_hint: Flutter API: ThemeData, MaterialApp.theme, Theme.of; docs cookbook/design/themes.md

claims.text: ThemeData(colorSchemeSeed: ...) generates a whole ColorScheme from one seed color (as ColorScheme.fromSeed); the scheme names roles including primary, onPrimary (content drawn on primary), surface (background of pages and bars) and error.
claims.source_hint: Flutter API: ThemeData colorSchemeSeed, ColorScheme.fromSeed, ColorScheme properties; docs cookbook/design/themes.md

claims.text: The primary generated from the indigo seed is not Colors.indigo itself: 0xFF515B92 versus 0xFF3F51B5.
claims.source_hint: flutter test on a stage-1 archive printing ThemeData(colorSchemeSeed: Colors.indigo, useMaterial3: true).colorScheme.primary and Colors.indigo

claims.text: Material widgets (AppBar, ElevatedButton, TextField) take default colors from the theme's ColorScheme; with Material 3, AppBar's background is surface, and ElevatedButton has a pale background (surfaceContainerLow) with its label in primary.
claims.source_hint: Flutter API: AppBar backgroundColor and ElevatedButton.styleFrom defaults for useMaterial3; flutter test on a stage-1 archive (AppBar Material color == surface, button text == primary)

claims.text: In Flutter 3.47 ThemeData.useMaterial3 already defaults to true, so useMaterial3: true in stage-1 main.dart changes nothing.
claims.source_hint: Flutter API: ThemeData.useMaterial3; docs release/breaking-changes/material-3-default.md; flutter test: ThemeData().useMaterial3 == true

claims.text: At stage-1 main.dart line 20 is the only theme setting; ProductListScreen and every screen it opens are built below that MaterialApp; no screen names a color for AppBar or ElevatedButton, and login_screen.dart:57 is the only color written in a screen.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang @ stage-1: DonHang.App/lib/main.dart:12-24, screens/*.dart (git grep 'Colors\.' stage-1 -- DonHang.App/lib)

claims.text: A TextStyle using Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error cannot be const: a Dart const value is fixed at compile time (as in C#) and cannot contain a call such as Theme.of(context), which runs when the app runs.
claims.source_hint: Dart language spec / dart.dev language/constants (const expressions); compile check in flutter analyze

claims.text: In the stage-1 theme colorScheme.error is 0xFFBA1A1A, darker than Colors.red (0xFFF44336); a TextField can show an error message under the field through its decoration (InputDecoration.errorText), drawn in colorScheme.error.
claims.source_hint: flutter test on a stage-1 archive (colorScheme.error, Colors.red, rendered color of errorText); Flutter API: InputDecoration.errorStyle default

claims.text: With colorSchemeSeed: Colors.teal the generated primary becomes teal-based (0xFF006A60) and surface changes slightly (0xFFF4FBF8, a faint teal tint), while a Text styled with Colors.red is unchanged.
claims.source_hint: flutter test on a stage-1 archive printing ThemeData(colorSchemeSeed: Colors.teal, useMaterial3: true).colorScheme

claims.text: Naming a color role instead of a raw value (a design token) lets one change to the theme reach every screen that names it; this pays off whenever the theme can change, such as a new seed or a second theme.

self_check.notes: Colors checked by flutter test on a stage-1 archive (indigo/teal seeds, AppBar/ElevatedButton/TextField errorText, useMaterial3 default).
